Recorded claim:
`AccessibilityUtils.assertCanBeClicked()` checks the composed target's nearest interactive accessible plus action count, focusability, visibility, enabled state, and label. Generic descendants/wrappers can therefore fail even when their parent looks accessible [Task 1]
